description:
Wait for a `one_shot` deploy to finish and return its final result as text.

    Takes the job_token `one_shot` returned. Waits until the deploy finishes, up
    to about 2.5 minutes; past that it returns ok:false with pending:true, and a
    later call with the same token picks the same deploy up again. It renders no
    card of its own: the one_shot deploy card is the visual, where the client
    renders it.

    `source == "community"` means the deploy used a pre-existing strategy by
    `@author` that the user picked. A `suggestion` is a community strategy that
    matched a vague request and was not deployed; it deploys only after the user
    has seen its author and code and picked it.

    Args:
      job_token: the token returned by `one_shot`.

    Returns:
      dict with: ok, stem, model, live_url, symbol, timeframe, channels (list),
      stats:{ret, wr, pf, n, mdd} (out-of-sample test-split metrics), source
      ("preset" | "generated" | "community"), author (community username if any),
      author_url + strategy_url (links for the author and the community strategy),
      community_id, suggest_custom (bool), suggestion ({community_id, title,
      author} or null: matched, not deployed), and note (a one-line summary of
      the source). On failure: {ok:false, error} (or {pending:true}).
name: get_deploy_result
title: Get Deploy Result
